payload.title: Audit unified CMS production release readiness for three consumers
payload.description: Read-only release audit of approved 63f1c87 preview versus production package and p.apyr.us, pilobol.us and threat-intelligence.anth.us consumers. Inventory all fixture/auth/storage/identity/command gaps; propose gated release, staging acceptance and rollback. Anth.us excluded. No push, merge, deploy, secrets, production data writes, IAM or OAuth changes.
